supersedes_only: Operational resource/scheduling assumptions in parallel_execution_plan_v1_2.json. Scientific experiment IDs, seeds, configs, initializations and analysis semantics are unchanged.

resource_envelope.scientific_process_model: one independent single-GPU child per physical/logical GPU slot

qualification_before_priority_freeze.source: G2A non-scientific runtime calibration on the exact frozen source, dependency stack, model initialization class and T4 GPU profile
allowed_measurements: wall-clock time for a frozen small number of optimizer steps or an equivalent non-result-bearing throughput probe
batch-size feasibility under the already-frozen scientific batch semantics

priority_freeze_algorithm.name: deterministic_longest_processing_time_first
priority_freeze_algorithm.purpose: Minimize expected makespan and maximize six-GPU utilization without changing scientific identity.
priority_freeze_algorithm.architecture_cost: For each model/condition execution profile, use the median per-step wall-clock duration from the sealed G2A qualification measurements. Teacher-feature and teacher-logits conditions are distinct profiles if their calibrated costs differ.
priority_freeze_algorithm.state_priority: Sort the 11 frozen states by descending sealed architecture/condition cost. Break equal-cost ties lexicographically by experiment_id.
priority_freeze_algorithm.freeze_point: Write the resulting ordered state list and the G2A evidence hash to a PRE_SCIENCE_SCHEDULER_FREEZE artifact before any continuation-state scientific optimizer step executes.
priority_freeze_algorithm.dynamic_dispatch: Initially dispatch the first six priority states to K1/GPU0, K1/GPU1, K2/GPU0, K2/GPU1, K3/GPU0, K3/GPU1 in that fixed slot order. Thereafter dispatch the next queued state to the first qualified slot that becomes free; simultaneous-free ties resolve by the same fixed slot order.
priority_freeze_algorithm.retry: A technical retry retains the exact experiment ID, seed, initialization, config and run scientific identity; retries do not reorder or create new scientific states.

throughput_invariants: six slots may be occupied concurrently after all corresponding G2A profiles pass
each child sees only its assigned CUDA device
each run has an isolated output/checkpoint namespace
durable checkpoint stores remain run-ID scoped and content-addressed
account or slot assignment may not change a run seed or initialization
completion order has no effect on analysis or selection eligibility
no scientific output may be read to change queue priority

failure_policy.slot_failure: Quarantine the affected slot/account until its G2A/runtime qualification is restored; other qualified slots continue.
failure_policy.run_failure: Resume or retry the same scientific state according to the existing checkpoint/recovery policy. No A02 run, substitute seed or substitute model is authorized.
failure_policy.capacity_loss: Continue with fewer qualified slots without changing scientific identity or priority ordering of not-yet-started states.
failure_policy.capacity_gain: No fourth account or additional slot may be introduced without a new pre-science execution-policy addendum; v1.2.1 assumes exactly three accounts/six GPU slots.
